# Türkiye Energy Intelligence Platform

> EnerjiNabız AI is an open-source research and engineering platform for Turkish electricity-market analytics, data quality, forecasting, anomaly detection, renewable-energy analysis, and BI-ready exports.

## Canonical resources

- Project website: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/turkiye-energy-intelligence-platform/
- Source repository: https://github.com/FaramarzKowsari/turkiye-energy-intelligence-platform
- Version v1.0.0 DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21749629
- All-versions DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21749628
- Author ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1692-0453

## Important context

- The bundled demonstration dataset is synthetic and clearly labelled.
- EPİAŞ connectivity is optional and uses credentials supplied privately by each user.
- The project is not affiliated with EPİAŞ, TEİAŞ, or the Government of Türkiye.
- Source-code license: MIT.
